name: langdock
title: Langdock
description: Chat with Langdock models and agents, ask about selections, web pages, screenshots and files, generate images, and work with prompts, knowledge, meetings, integrations, tasks and workflows.
author: Melvin2306

commands.name: ask-langdock
commands.title: Ask Langdock
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Ask a question and get a streamed answer from a Langdock model.

commands.name: ask-agent
commands.title: Ask Agent
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Chat with one of your Langdock agents.

commands.name: ask-about-selection
commands.title: Ask About Selection
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Ask a question about the selected text.

commands.name: summarize-selection
commands.title: Summarize Selection
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Summarize the selected text, or the clipboard if nothing is selected.

commands.name: translate-selection
commands.title: Translate Selection
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Translate the selected text, or the clipboard if nothing is selected.

preferences.name: defaultLanguage
preferences.title: Default Language
preferences.description: Language to translate into when none is given.

commands.name: improve-writing
commands.title: Improve Writing
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Fix spelling and grammar and improve the clarity of the selected text.

commands.name: explain-selection
commands.title: Explain Selection
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Explain the selected text in simple terms.

commands.name: ask-about-web-page
commands.title: Ask About Web Page
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Summarize or ask about the page open in your browser.

commands.name: ask-about-screenshot
commands.title: Ask About Screenshot
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Capture part of the screen and ask Langdock about it.

commands.name: ask-about-files
commands.title: Ask About Files
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Ask questions about files, such as the files selected in Finder.

commands.name: chat-history
commands.title: Chat History
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Search and continue your earlier Langdock conversations.

commands.name: search-prompts
commands.title: Search Prompts
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Search your Langdock prompt library and paste or run a prompt.

commands.name: search-knowledge
commands.title: Search Knowledge
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Search the knowledge bases shared with your API key.

commands.name: add-to-knowledge-base
commands.title: Add to Knowledge Base
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Upload files, such as the files selected in Finder, to a Langdock knowledge base.

commands.name: search-skills
commands.title: Search Skills
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Browse your Langdock skills and use them in a chat.

commands.name: search-meetings
commands.title: Search Meetings
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Search your Langdock meetings and read notes and transcripts.

commands.name: generate-image
commands.title: Generate Image
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Generate an image with an image model from your Langdock workspace.

commands.name: image-history
commands.title: Browse Generated Images
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Browse, copy and reuse images you generated.

commands.name: scheduled-tasks
commands.title: Manage Scheduled Tasks
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Run, pause and resume your Langdock scheduled tasks.

commands.name: create-scheduled-task
commands.title: Create Scheduled Task
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Create a Langdock scheduled task that runs a prompt on a schedule.

commands.name: workflows
commands.title: Browse Workflows
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Browse your Langdock workflows and their recent runs.

commands.name: run-integration-action
commands.title: Run Integration Action
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Run an action of a Langdock integration with your connection.

commands.name: open-langdock
commands.title: Open Langdock
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Open the Langdock desktop app, or the web app if it is not installed.

commands.name: settings
commands.title: Langdock Settings
commands.subtitle: Langdock
commands.description: Manage your API key, default models and image options, and check which Langdock APIs your key can use.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Personal or workspace API key from Langdock (Settings → Account → API keys). Langdock Settings shows which features the key can use.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
